visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and a black turtleneck stands in front of a white door, speaking and gesturing toward the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a standard, plain bathroom with white tiles, a white toilet, and a simple sink. (3) The image blurs and transitions to show the same bathroom now completely covered in reflective mirrors on the walls and floor, creating an infinite reflection effect. (4) The man returns to the frame, talking expressively about the transformation. (5) A hand is shown turning a silver door knob to reveal the mirrored interior of the bathroom. (6) The camera pans across the mirrored surfaces, reflecting the toilet and the man multiple times. (7) Close-up shots highlight the mirrored ceiling vent and the light fixture. (8) Quick before-and-after cuts compare the original tiled wall with the new mirrored surface. (9) The man enters the mirrored bathroom, holding a smartphone to record his own reflection, laughing and looking around at the multiple versions of himself. (10) He strikes several poses, including a thumbs up, while his reflection repeats infinitely behind him.
